title: Ultimate dome
desc: The oath look-up firing a B1 beam to the sky, then a 150-block construct barrier that forms over 10 s (top first, bottom a little after) and lasts 2.5 minutes.

takes.name: radius 150
takes.facts: oath, B1 beam up 2.5 s, dome forms top-down from 28, bottom-up from 60, closes at 228 (10 s), lasts 2.5 min, comes apart at 300

takes.name: radius 150, ribs first
takes.facts: 12 ribs race down first, panels fill between
